batting.name: SC Ganguly
batting.dismissal: c MV Boucher b R Vinay Kumar

batting.name: AN Ghosh
batting.dismissal: c MV Boucher b R Vinay Kumar

batting.name: AD Mathews
batting.dismissal: c V Kohli b A Kumble

batting.name: JD Ryder
batting.dismissal: c SC Ganguly b AB Agarkar

batting.name: JH Kallis
batting.dismissal: c BB McCullum b M Kartik

batting.name: RV Uthappa
batting.dismissal: c AD Mathews b M Kartik

balls.text: and Saha ends it brilliantly, steps out, gets a fulltoss, and smashes it over midwicket, what a shot, what an end
scoops, and seems to have forgotten that the fine leg is back, just a single, perhaps he was looking to go squarer
another slower ball, and Saha looks for a big hit, gets an inside edge onto his pad, but McCullum just wants the strike more than anything else and rushes through again
slower ball, gets an inside edge from McCullum who tries a heave
steps out, it's a good delivery, a yorker, and McCullum opens the face and beats thridman
another no-ball, and it's a foot call this time, yorker it is, and McCullum wants the free hit and refuses the single
and McCullum has come to party big party, this is a fulltoss, just above his waist, and pulled over deep backward square
bouncer first up, beats Saha, and McCullum runs through straight, and Boucher misses the stumps by a bit

and he has beaten fine leg again, this time moves across too early, and forces Vinay to bowl a slower delivery, and instead of scooping, McCullum pulls this over fine leg, what an innings this has been
McCullum you beauty, repeats the daylight robbery, Vinay tries the yorker this time, but McCullum gets across again, and scoops it between keeper and fine leg
lovely shot, the perfect scoop, walks across, gets into the infamous Misbah-esque posture, and scoops it over, straight over, the wicketkeeper's head
nice yorker, on off stump, and all Saha can do is dig it out and rush through for one
full, just short of being a yorker, and played towards extra cover
low fulltoss, and MucCullum smashes it towards sweeper-cover, and runs a quick two
flights it again, 82ks, towards middle, and played wristily between long-on and midwicket for two
just wide off off, just short of length, and opens the face
flighted again, and McCullum pulls out an immaculate forward-defensive
Mathews's unconvincing stay ends, he steps out again, lofts again, doesn't get the timing right again, but for a change finds the long-on
well flighted, McCullum has to step out to get close to it, and plays it down to long-on
McCullum looks for another slog-sweep, and misses, just misses the off stump too

Akhil is unlucky again, Mathews sends him an alert call before he is about to delivering, he shuffles across too early, looking for the scoop, Akhil bowls the slower bouncer, gets the edge, but it flies wide of Boucher
Boucher looks for one more slog-sweep, but this is not full enough, the mis-hit flies towards deep midwicket but falls short
better line, just outside off, and punched away towards sweeper-cover
not sure if that chat helped the bowler, this is short, into the pads, at gentle pace, and McCullum says thank you very much, pulling it over deep backward square, and gets his first 50 of the season
McCullum looks to get in his element, slog-sweeps Akhil over midwicket, not much pace on it anyway
Akhil replaces Ryder, and Mathews goes for the scoop again, and is early into it again, and ends up playing towards square leg
that's McCullum's best shot of the day, steps out, gets to the pitch, and lofts it over extra cover, he also has his highest score of this IPL
flighted, slower, on the pads and played towards midwicket
Mathews is lucky, looks to go in the air, straight down the ground, and it beats Akhil at long-on, who is slow in setting off
McCullum looks for the reverse, Kumble fires it in, 99ks, and only a limp edge towards fine leg
Mathews steps out, this is flatter, 93ks, and Mathews plays it down towards long-off
flights it, Mathews bunts it towards cover and wants to run, but is sent back
Mathews looks for the scoop, Ryder changes the pace, 117ks, takes too long to arrive, and Mathews just gets en edge towards square leg
low fulltoss, mis-hit towards long-on, but it doesn't carry that far
full and wide, and driven away to right of sweeper-cover, and it will only be a single
slower ball, 105ks, again yorkerish, and played down to long-off
tries the shorter one, and Mathews rocks back to pull it towards deep backward square
steps out, and gets too close to the pitch of the ball, and plays it back to Ryder
gets fuller this time, and Mathews plays it down towards long-off
on target this time, moving in towards the middle stump, and played with an open face
McCullum is quick, he waits a long time to late-cut this, but wastes no time in running two just to the right of third man
length ball, on the stumps, and he helps it towards fine leg
and gets a wide first up, down the leg side
and Hussey imrpovises once too often, clears front leg again, looks to go over midwicket, Akhil bowls straight, length, and Hussey misses, the middle stump doesn't
looks for the pull, but it's hardly there for it, too full in fact, and he manages the bottom part of the bat
top shot from Hussey, makes room again, and picks a length delivery over covers, and beats sweeper-cover
full, just outside off, and played towards long-off
slower ball, 102ks, turns out to be a yorker, dug out towards long-on
length ball, on off, and McCullum dabs it towards point
Hussey goes extra again, makes room by clearing his front leg, and places it wide of long-off
full, almost a yorker, played down the ground
cramps him up this time, Hussey looks to make room again, but it's full and into him, all he can do is defend it back
steps out, looks for a big one through covers, but the ball is nowhere near him, gets the toe of the bat for single towards thirdman
well bowled, well played, Hussey looks to make room, Akhil pulls the length back, and follows him, Hussey still manages to play with an open face towards thirdman
again just a single, on the off, on length, and played towards point for one
short and wide, McCullum looks for the cut, but gets a bottom-side edge, and looks for a single, but there isn't any
length ball on the off stump, Hussey plays it with an open face, and gets a single down to third man
full and wide, and too wide
another sharp ball, right on the off stump, and McCullum just defends it into covers
McCullum looks for the scoop, Ryder slips in a quicker one, which beats McCullum, the leg stump, and Boucher
good running this time, same delivery, on the off, and dabs it straight to point and runs
angling in, on a length, no room at all
goes for the yorker, it's a low fulltoss, though, played down the ground, 50 of the partnership
played, late late cut, only for a single though, but out of Boucher;s gloves this time
length ball, just outside off, and Hussey plays it just to right of point, and rushes through for a single
length ball, on off, Hussey plays to leg, and gets the leading edge
angled into the pads, and helped away towards fine leg
what a shot, clears his leg, and lofts this straight over long-off, effortless, and once he made his mind he had to go aerial he went the distance
thrown up, just outside off, and guides it to third man
throws it up, fullish, McCullum plays for the turn, and gets an inside edge
goes back to flight, straight, and McCullum gets across and sweeps it fine
faster one, and it goes just goes away just as fast, 93ks, and McCullum waits and guides it through point, good shot
flighted again, draws Hussey out, he obliges, gets to the pitch of the ball, and plays it down to long-on
another flighted delivery, too full, too straight, and swept away
again flights it, length ball, 78ks, turns too, and McCullum plays it towards point
flighted on off stump, Hussey drives it in orthodox manager, beats short cover's dive, and almost makes it to the boundary
almost there, slider, starts outside off, moves in, is sharp again, and again McCullum gets his bat down just in time
oh he is going for the lbw, keep your pads protected, length ball, sharp, on the stumps, defended
that's close, slips in a quicker one, 100ks, McCullum gets the bat down in time
short, looks for cut, but that's a googly, is cramped for room, and dabs it for one to short third
thrown up, 88k, dips on Hussey and he plays it back to Kumble
full, outside off, driven back to Kumble
fullish, into the pads, and an easy single to deep square leg
good length, just outside off, and he plays with an open face for a single
fuller, wider, and driven down to long-off
bunts and runs, length delivery on the off stump, and drops it into the off side
dropped, Kiwi to Kiwi, thick outside edge, Boucher is up to the stumps, and it's tough to hold on to it, and the ball flies off his gloves
back of a length, rools his fingers on it, and played towards point
half-lucky this time, steps out again, the idea ir right, going over cover, but the thick outside edge takes it over point
mis-hit for a six! slower ball no less, Hussey steps out, makes room, but gets the bottom of the bat, and plays it with one hand off the handle, over covers for six

oh almost, what a good effort from Boucher, Kallis throws this up wide of off, Hussey pokes without feet, the ball takes the edge and dies on Boucher, and he dives forward and manages to take it on half-volley
again the short length, moving into the ribs, McCullum bunts it down and runs a quick single
thrown up a bit, not drivable length yet, and McCullum opens his face on it, but can't find the gap
just back of a length again, on off, and McCullum gets on his toes to defend it into the off side
pulls the length back a bit, outside off, and Hussey lets it go through to Boucher
pitched up and he pays the price, a full-faced orthodox on-drive, and the mid-on is pretty close so there is no time to get around
back of a length, outside off, and McCullum gets across to get in line with it, and helps it towards fine leg
back of a length, into the ribs, and Hussey gets back and nudges it for a single into the on side
oh my Ghosh! he walks across again, Vinay slips in a short one that gets big on him, and he looks to cut it over point, but all he manages is a nice little nick, okay bye
that is improvisation, it's a tailender's shot, Ghosh walks across, gets on a knee, and slog-swats it over midwicket
short again, tucking Ghosh up, played into the on side for one
short, it's wide, and there for the cut, but the extra bounce beats Ghosh
drifts onto the pads this time, and easily helped away towards fine leg
back of a length, on the stumps, McCullum doesn't move his feet, opens up and defends it back to the bowler
Kallis gets sharper, 133ks, just outside off, on a good length, and moving in towards the stumps, McCullum defends
McCullum plays and misses again, it's length ball, wide outside off, there for the booming drive that McCullum tries, but he is nowhere near the ball
another length ball outside off, and Ghosh defends with an open face, goes straight to Kohli at point
wide length ball, Ghosh drives on the up, but straight towards Kohli at point
length ball on the off, Ghosh gets on the front foot and across, and plays it around his pad, and places it well for a two to deep backward square

edged and taken, lovely bowling too, after pushing him off to the back foot, he slips in one fuller that pitches on a length, pitches leg, and moves away, taking the edge, Praveen Kumar - Vinay's team-mate - will approve
persists with back-of-a-length, no room at all, and Ganguly defends with an open face
tries a bouncer at Ganguly again, and this one is a good one, pitches leg, and rises towards the throat, Ganguly ducks
that's a top shot, lovely square-drive, this one was again a loose delivery, wide and just short of being a half-volley, and McCullum drives it between point and cover, more timing than power
this one cut back in a touch, short of a good length, pitches outside off, and heads towards the stumps, McCullum defends
length ball outside off, and McCullum lets it go
on target now, just back of a length, and defended towards cover
that's not good to look at, McCullum looks to make room and slashes, but misses completely
a gentle loosener there, half-volley outside off, and McCullum leads into him and crashes it through the covers
steps out, doesn't trust the bounce anymore, and slashes, gets a thick outside edge over slips, that's FOURtunate
ooo this lifted from nowhere, just back of a length, 130ks only, but rises steeply, and Ganguly does well to not play at it, looks at the surface with mistrust
just back of a length, angling across Ganguly, and defended into the off side
length ball, just outside off, and McCullum steers it to third man
slight swing there, pitched up, around off, and shaping away a bit, McCullum defends with an open face
back of a length, outside off, and McCullum lets it go

Taylor has finished this one with what has been symbolic of the last five overs, he walks across, gets a fulltoss giftwrapped for him (to Ross Taylor, with love), and he picks it up - huge over midwicket, the story of this chase really
and he gets away with one, leg stump, length, had Boucher connected it would have been over now, but one leg bye comes nonetheless
Taylor you beauty, he has killed this, low fulltoss again, and Taylor has played a little pick-up over long-on
and he bowls a perfect yorker, angling down the leg, but the problem has been that between those two yorkers he has fit in some loose bowling
lucky you Ajit, another fulltoss, on the pads, and Taylor misses out, hits it straight to midwicket, where Mendis fumbles and misses out on a run-out chance that could have been close
walks down and across, hits towards long-on, two is the immediate call, and two it is, because it isn't hit too powerfully
that's foolish, this is a third fulltoss from Agarkar in the last two overs, and Taylor helps himself to a huge six - no discredit to Taylor, but this is poor bowling
Agarkar starts off with a perfect yorker, just outside off, and he takes it over two-a-ball again
yeah yeah yeah, shouts Boucher as he digs out this yorker, and the yeah means they want two, and Taylor responds superbly, and is back on strike for the next over
that's a stupid stupid thing, high fulltoss, on the pads, and Boucher pulls it over deep backward square, what's more - it's a no-ball for height
moves across, gets too close to the pitch, can't get the elevation, and gets a single to sweeper-cover
almost bowled him, and that's four, this is a good yorker, Taylor looks to go on side, gets an inside edge that misses the stumps and the keeper, we are in for a tight one
mid-off is up, Taylor sees it, and this time goes straight, Taylor hits this length ball over mid-off, he is keeping them alive here
that was a powerful shot, a half-volley outside off, and Boucher went hard at it, but straight to sweeper-cover
yorker outside off, Boucher already making room is too far from the ball

and another four, it gives Taylor his 50, and Bangalore the second boundary of the over, Taylor moves towards off stump, and targeted the short fine leg, got it to left of him and it was four as soon as he did that
bowling, a good yorker, just outside off, dug out, and they will get just one
full, outside off, Boucher doesn't connect as he would like, but it bounces over cover, and they get two
full and straight, and he plays it down to long-on
smart slower bouncer, and Taylor can't do anything about it - one bouncer for the over
and he has given Taylor the first boundary of the minimum two required, juicy fulltoss on the pads, and smashed away to square leg, "come hit me," it said
another dot ball, what an over, full and flat, and played towards cover
the googly, the umpire may have missed it, it beat Boucher who played for the legbreak, the umpire reckoned it hit him outside the line of off
caught and bowled, carrom ball, turns away, not much, but Dravid has already moved away from the line, and the bottom part of the bat hits the ball straight back to Mendis who takes an easy catch
flat outside off, and chopped towards point, they get a single, although the third umpire has been called to adjudicate
Dravid goes for the paddle sweep, this is outside off, and he almost plays it on to his off stump
misfield by Mendis gives them a single, it was hit back to him, but he fumbled, and the batsmen were alert

what running from Taylor, slower ball, Dravid checks his shot, goes straight to sweeper-cover, but not that fast, and Taylor sees his opportunity, runs two, towards the danger end, and keeps the strike
that was very well bowled, slower ball, outside off, close to the tram line, but it's called a wide
smart bowling, Dravid looks to make room, Ishant goes wide of off stump, and well done to stay away from that wide line
misses out on a fulltoss, walks across too early, and gets just a single to long-on
just back of a length, and outside off, and played late towards third man
Dravid lets out a loud cry of disappointment, because this was short and wide, and just got too big on him - he could neither cut it not get a single
and four right away, this game has come to life, wide delivery, Dravid gets his front foot out, and slices it over point, what a shot
another four, what an over for Bangalore, Taylor walks across his stumps, Mathews holds the off-stump line, and he gets a thick inside edge, and it's too fine of the fine leg
bowls a leg-stump yorker, and Dravid does well to dig it out and hand the strike over to Taylor
fulltoss on the pads, misses out, and plays it along the ground towards midwicket
poor bowling, half-volley on pads, with short fine up, and it's easily helped away past short fine
superb shot again, walks across, knows fine leg is up, gets inside the line and pulls it to the left of short fine
run-out missed, yorker, played towards long-on, they push for two, the throw is flat and hard, but just a bit wide, had Mathews collected completely Dravid was gone
flat, into the pads, and single down towards square leg
it's better second time around, moves across this time, this is slower, he still goes with the slog-sweep, and this goes squarer - and longer
and there comes out Taylor's favourite area; length ball on the pads, and he flicks it over midwicket, just walks across and connects
lovely bowling, holds it back again, 77ks, on the stumps, turning just that little bit, and played towards cover
quicker now, full, outside off, and hit straight back to Kartik
almost a return catch, slow, thrown up, beats Dravid in flight, the leading edge just evades Kartik
full, outside off, and played between long-off and extra cover for two
bowls the googly, with a silly point in, but the turn is nhot sharp, and Dravid plays it down to long-on
tries the topspinner, hurries Taylor into the pull, which goes straight to short fine, and they manage a single despite a direct hit from Yashpal
throws it up, but on the pads, easy single, though KKR won't mind it
flat, fast, 96ks, just outside off, and steered straight to point
full, on off, and played down the ground for one
flat slog-sweep, good shot actually, but straight down the throat of deep backward square leg, the ball was perhaps a bit too close to Uthappa so he got the power but couldn't get the elevation
yorks him, full and low, on the pads, and only a single ensues, towards midwicket
plays the late-cut, from in front of stumps, but there isn't enough pace of the ball to beat short third man
throws it up, on the pads, and played into the on side for one
flat and full, 100ks Taylor still manages to chop it towards point, but can't beat the fielder
length ball on the pads, and played away for an easy single
shortish and wide, and played towards third man
slower ball, Uthappa is on the front foot, and checks his shot, playing it into the ground

this could have been a run-out, but ended up being five - the ball stopped on Taylor a bit, but he ran for a sharp single to mid-off, Hussey went for the stumps, would have got his man had he hit, and neither the keeper nor the slip is backing up, and the overthrow beats the fine leg
fullish, on the stumps, and played down to long-on
Kolkata are closing in here, big wicket, Ryder looks to go over covers, makes room, manages to only slice it, and the ball flies straight to third man, where Ganguly takes the sitter
Ryder looks to pull, but this one stays low, outside off, so the stumps are safe
flighted outside off, and played towards short third
on middle and leg, and whipped away towards deep square leg
that's an arm ball, hurries Uthappa up, but he will get a single
wide down the leg side
flights it, onto the pads, and turned away towards midwicket for two

what a catch, take a bow Baz, this one was a short ball, punched away wide of cover - hold on not wide enough for McCullum - he absolutely flew, and caught it when the ball had gone past it. The captain is enjoying it today
bowling Kartik, turn and bounce, more bounce than turn, pitches off and kicks up
strays onto the pads, and helped away towards midwicket - not much spin so far for Mendis, one that spun took a thick outside edge and went for four
another flat ball on the stumps, and defended back towards the bowler
back of a length, guided towards backward point
full, on the stumps, and defended
looks to go over extra, gets to thirdman, but four runs it is, the carrom ball took a thick edge
straight and flat, back of a length, hurries Kallis into a defensive shot
fullish, on the pads, bunted away towards midwicket, wants two but decides against it
short this time, and pulled away towards midwicket to bring up the 50
flighted, Ryder looks for the slog-sweep, but is early into the shot
length ball, outside off, and played towards extra cover for an easy single
full and wide down the leg side
flighted outside off, and square-driven for a single
and on target right away, back of a length, straight, and played towards short midwicket
misses out on a leg-stump half-volley there, just falling over a bit
another gift without a wrapper, long-hop, into Kallis's pads, and pulled away
on target, length ball, and played back
if it's flying it has to be McCullum, another lovely shot seemingly through extra cover, but McCullum makes a goalkeeper-type save
uff what a shot, fulltoss all right, but Ryder finds the gap between short cover and mid-off, that's threaded through
on the pads, flat, at 98ks, and played towards square leg
fulltoss, and Ryder accepts it with gratitude, one smooth motion, and the ball clears mid-off easily
slower ball, Ryder is clearly early into this lofted shot over covers, but the sliced shot carries it far enough for him to be safe
back of a length, angled into the pads, and bunted away for one
slower ball, but is wide down the leg side
Kallis shuffles across, looks for the drop-kick, and misses it outside off
back of a length, just outside off, and Kallis plays it to cover
length ball to start with, angling across Ryder, and played with an open face
this is a poor delivery, angling into the pads, but Kallis misses it, and it takes the thigh pad on the way, else it was a wide
lovely shot again, half-shimmy, sees the slower ball early, 107ks</i., gets down on a knee, and lofts it over extra cover, high elbow and all
surprise bouncer, and a pretty good one, Kallis is clearly late, plays it in front of his head, underside edge
shot! steps down makes some room, frees his arm, and just chips it over cover, safe shot
just back of a length, on the off stump, punched away, straight to cover
Kallis misses out on this, juicy half-volley on the pads, but plays inside the line, was perhaps expecting some swing
fullish, on the stumps, and defended towards midwicket
short, on the pads, pulled with front foot in the air, and beats deep backward square leg, natural shot for Ryder
yorker, 141ks, on the pads, and dug out for a dot
length, outside off, and played towards third man
that was quick, 145ks, just outside off, it's just a length ball that rises high enough for Saha to collect it in front of his face
short and wide, misses Kallis's cut, and is called wide
and Mendis has given Kallis a life, Kallis upper-cuts, doesn't connect properly, Mendis runs in from thirdman, only to find he has run in too far and has been lobbed
googly this time, on the pads though, and an easy single ensues
gets fuller, and on the pads this time, easy single to fine leg
another carrom ball, flat, just back of a length, and defended wristily towards midwicket
carrom ball now, full, on the stumps, and played towards long-on
bowls the googly, gets an inside edge from Kallis but he is safe
and the free hit is hit straight down the throat of Agarkar at long-on, it will be just a single
he starts with a no-ball, otherwise it was accurate and got just a defensive prod
another tight delivery, just outside off, just back of a  length, and played into the covers
slightly fuller, but wide, and Kallis goes for the cut, and hits straight to cover
continues to stay back of a length, and Kallis shoulders arms, although this one moves in the bounce takes it over the stumps
short and wide, Kallis goes fir the upper cut, but the extra bounce beats him, was bowled at 138ks
another short delivery, this one jabs in, and Kallis just defends it into the off side
Ishant stays short again, and it's wide outside off, and left alone
short, 139ks, and off the thigh pad towards fine leg
